lines.text: Paul and his companions sail from Paphos to Perga, where John leaves them and returns to Damascus.
The people ask for a king, and God gives them Saul son of Kish, who rules forty years.
The people of Jerusalem and their rulers ask Herod to have Jesus executed, though they find no ground for death.
David fell asleep and his body saw decay, but the One God raised did not see decay.
The Jews stir up persecution and drive Paul and Barnabas out, and they shake the dust off their feet.
